slide1.headline: OpenAI to Launch GPT-5.6
slide1.subtitle: After US Delays Release Over AI Security Concerns

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 08 Jul 2026
OpenAI is set to launch its new GPT-5.6 model after the US delayed its release due to AI security concerns
The US government had raised concerns over the potential risks of the model
OpenAI has since addressed these concerns and is now ready to launch the model
with improved security measures in place
